reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Alabama
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that unpaid rent was
    lawfully withheld (including alternative housing / rent abatement due to lack of repairs/services)?
*/

/* =========================
   BASIC HELPERS (pure logic)
   ========================= */

days_at_least(FromDay, ToDay, MinDays) :-
    integer(FromDay),
    integer(ToDay),
    integer(MinDays),
    ToDay - FromDay >= MinDays.

nonneg_int(N) :-
    integer(N),
    N >= 0.

/* =========================
   SCENARIO FACTS (question statement encoded)
   ========================= */

state(alabama).
focus_year(2021).

tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).
dwelling(d1).
lease(lease1).
lease_parties(lease1, l1, t1).
lease_dwelling(lease1, d1).

/* Eviction action for possession based on alleged nonpayment */
action(a1).
action_type(a1, possession).
action_basis(a1, nonpayment_of_rent).
action_parties(a1, l1, t1).
tenant_in_possession(a1, t1, yes).

/* Tenant did not pay rent; tenant asserts it was "lawfully withheld" due to lack of repairs/services */
rent_accrued_amount(a1, 1000).                    % alleged accrued rent
tenant_withheld_rent(t1, yes).
tenant_claims_lawful_withholding_due_to_repairs_or_services(t1, yes).

/* Underlying conditions tenant points to */
landlord_noncompliance_health_safety(l1, d1, yes).   % violation materially affecting health/safety
essential_service_missing(l1, d1, yes).              % e.g., heat/water/etc

/* Tenant gave notice(s), but did NOT terminate and did NOT vacate */
notice_401_delivered(t1, l1, receipt_day(10), termination_day(25)).  % >=14 days (25-10=15)
breach_remedied_within_notice_period(l1, d1, no).
condition_caused_by_tenant_or_family_or_guests(t1, d1, no).

notice_404_delivered(t1, l1, receipt_day(10), termination_day(25)).  % >=14 days
landlord_failed_promptly_restore_essential_service(l1, d1, yes).
tenant_vacated_premises(t1, d1, no).               % key: tenant stayed

/* Tenant also did not pay accrued rent into court (relevant to AL 35-9A-405(a) procedure) */
tenant_paid_into_court(a1, t1, 0).

/* For completeness: tenant could claim damages for noncompliance/essential services,
   but the scenario is specifically about "withholding" rent, and the tenant hasn't complied
   with the rent-into-court requirement for possession actions. */
tenant_claimed_damages_amount(a1, t1, 1000).

/* Scenario summary predicate required by instructions */
scenario_statement :-
    state(alabama),
    focus_year(2021),
    action(a1),
    action_type(a1, possession),
    action_basis(a1, nonpayment_of_rent),
    action_parties(a1, l1, t1),
    tenant_in_possession(a1, t1, yes),
    tenant_withheld_rent(t1, yes),
    tenant_claims_lawful_withholding_due_to_repairs_or_services(t1, yes),
    landlord_noncompliance_health_safety(l1, d1, yes),
    essential_service_missing(l1, d1, yes),
    tenant_vacated_premises(t1, d1, no).

/* =========================
   STATUTE TRANSLATIONS
   ========================= */

/* --- AL Code  35-9A-401 (2021): Noncompliance by the landlord --- */

/* Tenant may terminate if: material noncompliance affecting health/safety, written notice,
   termination date >=14 days after receipt, breach not remedied, and not caused by tenant. */
legal_401_tenant_may_terminate(Lease) :-
    lease_parties(Lease, L, T),
    lease_dwelling(Lease, D),
    landlord_noncompliance_health_safety(L, D, yes),
    notice_401_delivered(T, L, receipt_day(R), termination_day(Term)),
    days_at_least(R, Term, 14),
    breach_remedied_within_notice_period(L, D, no),
    condition_caused_by_tenant_or_family_or_guests(T, D, no).

/* Under 35-9A-401, tenant may recover damages/injunctive relief for landlord noncompliance.
   (No explicit rent withholding/abatement right is created in the provided text.) */
legal_401_tenant_may_recover_damages(Lease) :-
    lease_parties(Lease, L, T),
    lease_dwelling(Lease, D),
    landlord_noncompliance_health_safety(L, D, yes),
    condition_caused_by_tenant_or_family_or_guests(T, D, no).

/* --- AL Code  35-9A-404 (2021): Essential services --- */

/* Tenant may rightfully terminate without further obligation/penalty ONLY if:
   - essential services missing contrary to lease or 204
   - after notice, landlord willfully/negligently fails to promptly restore
   - tenant sends written notice with termination date >=14 days after receipt
   - and UPON VACATION of the premises (vacation is required by the text). */
legal_404_tenant_may_terminate_without_further_obligation(Lease) :-
    lease_parties(Lease, L, T),
    lease_dwelling(Lease, D),
    essential_service_missing(L, D, yes),
    notice_404_delivered(T, L, receipt_day(R), termination_day(Term)),
    days_at_least(R, Term, 14),
    landlord_failed_promptly_restore_essential_service(L, D, yes),
    condition_caused_by_tenant_or_family_or_guests(T, D, no),
    tenant_vacated_premises(T, D, yes).

/* Tenant may recover damages based on diminution in fair rental value (no rent withholding stated). */
legal_404_tenant_may_recover_diminution_damages(Lease) :-
    lease_parties(Lease, L, T),
    lease_dwelling(Lease, D),
    essential_service_missing(L, D, yes),
    notice_404_delivered(T, L, _Receipt, _Term),
    landlord_failed_promptly_restore_essential_service(L, D, yes),
    condition_caused_by_tenant_or_family_or_guests(T, D, no).

/* --- AL Code  35-9A-405 (2021): Counterclaims in possession/rent actions --- */

/* Tenant may counterclaim for any amount recoverable under rental agreement or chapter. */
legal_405_tenant_may_counterclaim(Action) :-
    action(Action),
    action_type(Action, possession),
    action_parties(Action, _L, T),
    tenant(T).

/* In possession action when tenant is in possession, tenant SHALL pay rent accrued and accruing into court. */
legal_405_rent_into_court_required(Action, Required) :-
    action(Action),
    action_type(Action, possession),
    action_parties(Action, _L, T),
    tenant_in_possession(Action, T, yes),
    rent_accrued_amount(Action, Required),
    nonneg_int(Required).

/* Court determines net amount. If no rent remains due after application, judgment for tenant in action for possession. */
legal_405_no_rent_remains_due_after_offset(Action) :-
    rent_accrued_amount(Action, Rent),
    action_parties(Action, _L, T),
    tenant_claimed_damages_amount(Action, T, Damages),
    nonneg_int(Rent),
    nonneg_int(Damages),
    Net is Rent - Damages,
    Net =< 0.

/* For this program's reasoning: to use the 405(a) "no rent remains due after application" path
   in a possession action where the tenant remains in possession, the tenant must have paid accrued rent into court. */
legal_405_defense_effective_in_possession_action(Action) :-
    action(Action),
    action_type(Action, possession),
    action_parties(Action, _L, T),
    tenant_in_possession(Action, T, yes),
    legal_405_tenant_may_counterclaim(Action),
    legal_405_rent_into_court_required(Action, Required),
    tenant_paid_into_court(Action, T, Paid),
    nonneg_int(Paid),
    Paid >= Required,
    legal_405_no_rent_remains_due_after_offset(Action).

/* --- AL Code  35-9A-501 (2021): Retaliation defense (not about rent abatement/withholding) --- */

/* Retaliatory action for possession: tenant has defense if landlord brought possession action because of protected conduct.
   (This program includes the rule, but the scenario facts do not assert retaliation.) */
protected_tenant_conduct(t_complained_to_agency).
protected_tenant_conduct(t_complained_to_landlord_about_204).
protected_tenant_conduct(t_joined_tenants_union).

tenant_did_protected_conduct(_T, _Conduct) :- fail.  % scenario does not include retaliation facts
landlord_action_motivated_by_protected_conduct(_L, _T, _Action) :- fail.

legal_501_retaliation_defense_available(Action) :-
    action(Action),
    action_type(Action, possession),
    action_parties(Action, L, T),
    protected_tenant_conduct(C),
    tenant_did_protected_conduct(T, C),
    landlord_action_motivated_by_protected_conduct(L, T, Action).

/* --- AL Code  35-9A-424 (2021): Waiver by acceptance of rent ---
   Not relevant to withholding; included for completeness. */
landlord_accepted_rent_with_knowledge_of_default(_L, _T, _Lease) :- fail.
legal_424_landlord_waived_right_to_terminate_for_breach(Lease) :-
    lease_parties(Lease, L, T),
    landlord_accepted_rent_with_knowledge_of_default(L, T, Lease).

/* =========================
   LEGAL ISSUE: "lawfully withheld" / rent abatement defense in eviction
   ========================= */

/* A "lawful withholding/abatement defense" exists here only if some encoded statute
   actually excuses rent payment (full/partial) while the tenant remains in possession,
   or otherwise makes the alleged unpaid rent not due.

   From the provided Alabama statutes:
   - 401: termination + damages/injunction, but no rent withholding/abatement stated.
   - 404: termination without further obligation ONLY upon vacation; otherwise damages.
   - 405: can defeat possession if no rent remains due after applying net amounts,
           but requires paying accrued rent into court while in possession.
   - 501: retaliation defense is unrelated to repair-based withholding.
*/
legal_lawful_withholding_defense_in_eviction(Action) :-
    (   legal_501_retaliation_defense_available(Action)
    ;   legal_404_tenant_may_terminate_without_further_obligation(lease1)
    ;   legal_405_defense_effective_in_possession_action(Action)
    ),
    !.

/* Determine if tenant can raise the specific defense "unpaid rent was lawfully withheld"
   on these facts (repairs/services withholding / abatement). */
can_tenant_rebut_nonpayment_with_lawful_withholding_defense(Action) :-
    action(Action),
    action_type(Action, possession),
    action_basis(Action, nonpayment_of_rent),
    action_parties(Action, _L, T),
    tenant_withheld_rent(T, yes),
    tenant_claims_lawful_withholding_due_to_repairs_or_services(T, yes),
    legal_lawful_withholding_defense_in_eviction(Action),
    !.

can_tenant_rebut_nonpayment_with_lawful_withholding_defense(_Action) :-
    fail.

/* =========================
   FINAL ANSWER
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    can_tenant_rebut_nonpayment_with_lawful_withholding_defense(a1),
    !.

housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* =========================
   MAIN
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that unpaid rent was lawfully withheld? This includes where the law allows a tenant to procure reasonable alternative housing due to lack of repairs or services, and was excused from paying rent, or where the law allows a tenant to abate rent either in part or in full due to lack of repairs.
